lectus, lectī m.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

bed or couch

Examples

  • Necesse est tibi manēre in lectō duōs trēsve diēs.

    You must stay in bed for two or three days.Traupman 56

  • lectō tenērī

    to be confined to bedCic. Verr. 2.5.16 (Lewis & Short s.v. lectus)

See also pillow, blanket, sheet, mattress, bed frame, make the bed, family bed, get up, go to bed, duvet.
